subject.title: [Bug]: CLI relay exits silently with code 1 when session lane is blocked — no timeout or busy error surfaced

question: Should same-session `openclaw agent` CLI lane waits become a terminal structured busy result, or should the CLI preserve queued execution and only improve diagnostics?
rationale: Current main exposes the needed facts internally, but returning a terminal busy result changes the CLI delivery contract and exit-code behavior for existing operator scripts.

options.title: Land structured busy result
options.body: Repair and land the linked PR direction so CLI callers get actionable stderr/JSON for lane-busy waits while non-CLI Gateway calls stay unopted.

options.title: Keep queued execution
options.body: Preserve eventual queued execution and add clearer CLI progress or timeout diagnostics instead of terminal busy rejection.

options.title: Pause for queue policy
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers settle the broader lane-wait policy across CLI, Gateway, and channels.

recommendation.title: Land structured busy result
recommendation.body: Repair and land the linked PR direction so CLI callers get actionable stderr/JSON for lane-busy waits while non-CLI Gateway calls stay unopted.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision sits at the Gateway-backed agent CLI boundary introduced in the earlier relay work and is a product/API contract choice.
